housing.summary: August 2026 average monthly rent for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre is USD 1,932.44. Rent source https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Nashville | Tennessee deposit practice is typically one to two months of rent. Deposit source https://riooapp.com/blog/tennessee-security-deposit-laws | A major Nashville rental-listings portal is Rent.com. Portal source https://www.rent.com/tennessee/nashville-apartments

banking.summary: Bank of America says eligible non-U.S. citizens opening in person need proof of both foreign and U.S. addresses, two IDs, and a tax identification number. Official bank source https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account
required_docs: proof of home or permanent residence address
one primary ID such as a foreign passport
one secondary ID such as a driver's license or major debit/credit card
foreign tax identification number, or U.S. TIN/ITIN if already issued

schools.summary: Metro Nashville Public Schools offers International Baccalaureate and Cambridge International programs. Curricula source https://www.mnps.org/experience | Tennessee's official approved nonpublic-schools directory can be used to verify private-school approval. Directory source https://www.tn.gov/education/families/school-options/non-public-schools.html

legal_admin.summary: There is no Nashville municipal residence-registration step identified. At the federal level, most noncitizens must report a U.S. address change to USCIS within 10 days of moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are excluded. Authority source https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange
legal_admin.registration_step: Report a change of U.S. address to USCIS within 10 days of moving, normally through the USCIS online account's Enterprise Change of Address tool; stated exceptions apply.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who is not eligible for a Social Security number and needs a U.S. federal tax number can apply to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and supporting identity and foreign-status documents. Authority source https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/how-to-apply-for-an-itin

transport.summary: Nashville's network is WeGo Public Transit; adult local service is capped at USD 65 for a full calendar month. Fare source https://www.wegotransit.com/buy/fare-information/ | New residents from other countries must take vision, knowledge, and road-skills tests for a Tennessee licence and may retain their foreign licence. Licence source https://www.tn.gov/safety/driver-services/classd/dlnew.html | Eligible residents can apply for Tennessee's public Medicaid program, TennCare, online through TennCare Connect, by phone, or by paper. Healthcare source https://www.tn.gov/tenncare/members-applicants/how-do-i-apply-for-tenncare.html
transport.driving_licence_exchange: No automatic exchange is stated for new residents from other countries: apply at a full-service Driver Services Center and pass the vision screening, Tennessee knowledge test, and road skills test; the foreign licence may be retained.
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible, apply for TennCare through TennCare Connect online, by phone at 855-259-0701, or with a paper application.
